text: StayTogether with LocateMotion is an affordable IoT solution designed to care for loved ones with Alzheimer, Dementia, and Autism who are prone to wandering.
Nauman Jaffar is the creator of StayTogether with LocateMotion.
The project received CA$ 1,505 from 23 backers on Kickstarter.
The funding period for the project was from January 10, 2018, to February 9, 2018.
The project is based in Toronto, Canada.
The project aims to provide a simple and complete solution for individuals who need support.
The project was last updated on February 9, 2018.
The project is categorized under Software on Kickstarter.
LocateMotion offers an affordable IoT solution designed to care for loved ones who are prone to wandering or need support.
The solution includes an iOS and Android app, 3G/4G connectivity, and a GPS low power smartwatch.
LocateMotion provides a 30-day money back guarantee and after-sales support.
The key differentiation of LocateMotion's solution is that it is the only complete out-of-the-box and most affordable solution in the market today.
The first generation of the product is an IoT smartwatch, while future generations may include low powered IoT devices like a pendant or wallet card.
The solution uses a Global IoT Nano-SIM or e-SIM that connects with the LocateMotion application 24/7.
The device operates as long as it has cellular, Wi-Fi, or GPS coverage.
The first generation solution has a battery life of 3 days, while the second generation is expected to be smaller with a discharge life of 3-6 months.
The second generation will also have capabilities to measure vital health stats like EKG and sugar levels for proactive health monitoring.
